summary: Black Titan Corp filed a Form 6-K to disclose the resignation of Co-CEO and director Chay Weei Jye, effective June 12, 2026. The resignation was not due to any policy disagreement and no severance was paid. The departing executive is thanked for his service. This is a routine management departure, not a forced or abrupt change that itself constitutes an event. No special-situation terms or conditions are present.
